selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
进攻性的战斗姿态，使你的自动攻击伤害提高15%，并使你受到的恐惧、闷棍和瘫痪效果持续时间缩短10%。

效果将一直持续直到取消。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
An aggressive combat state that increases the damage of your auto-attacks by 15% and reduces the duration of Fear, Sap and Incapacitate effects on you by 10%.

Lasts until canceled.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
立即攻击目标，造成([59% of Attack Power])点伤害，并为你恢复30%的最大生命值。

杀死一个可为你提供经验值或荣誉值的敌人，将重置胜利在望的冷却时间并使其不消耗怒气。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Instantly attack the target, causing (59% of Attack Power) damage and healing you for 30% of your maximum health.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor resets the cooldown of Impending Victory and makes it cost no Rage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
武器
你的自动攻击会额外产生1050%的怒气。

消灭一名敌人会立即产生5点怒气，并使你的移动速度提高30%，持续8秒。

 狂怒,  防护
你的自动攻击会额外产生50%的怒气。

消灭一名敌人会立即产生5点怒气，并使你的移动速度提高30%，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Arms
Your auto-attacks generate 1050% more Rage.

Killing an enemy instantly generates 5 Rage and increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.

 Fury,  Protection
Your auto-attacks generate 50% more Rage.

Killing an enemy instantly generates 5 Rage and increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
释放集结呐喊，使40码范围内的所有小队或团队成员的当前生命值和最大生命值提高10%，持续10秒。

不在团队中时，获得的生命值提高50%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Lets loose a rallying cry, granting all party or raid members within 40 yards 10% temporary and maximum health for 10 sec.

Health granted increased by 50% when not in a raid.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 将你的武器掷向一名敌人，造成([28.5% of Attack Power])点物理伤害并使其昏迷4秒。 [风暴众锤: 额外击中附近的2名敌人，使其昏迷2秒。]

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
武器,  狂怒
朝目标区域腾空跃起，同时以毁灭性的力量重击地面，对8码范围内的所有敌人造成([23.5% of Attack Power])点物理伤害。

 防护
朝目标区域腾空跃起，同时以毁灭性的力量重击地面，对8码范围内的所有敌人造成([23.5% of Attack Power])点物理伤害并重置嘲讽的剩余冷却时间。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Protection
Leap through the air toward a target location, slamming down with destructive force to deal (23.5% of Attack Power) Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards and resetting the remaining cooldown on Taunt.

 Arms,  Fury
Leap through the air toward a target location, slamming down with destructive force to deal (23.5% of Attack Power) Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
防护

 狂怒

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 向敌人投掷你的武器，造成([600% of Attack Power])点物理伤害，无视护甲。最多对吸收护盾造成额外500%的伤害。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
武器
每消耗20点怒气用于攻击，就会使天神下凡和巨人打击的剩余冷却时间缩短1秒。

selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Arms
Every 20 Rage you spend on attacks reduces the remaining cooldown on Avatar and Colossus Smash by 1 sec.

 Fury

 Protection
Every 20 Rage you spend reduces the remaining cooldown on Avatar and Shield Wall by 1 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的怒吼技能获得额外效果。

selectedNodes.descriptionEn: The effects of your shouts last 20% longer.

selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Healing received increased by 3% and all self-healing increased by an additional 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 旋风斩影响所有带有撕裂的目标，使其流血，在15秒内造成([190.465% of Attack Power])点伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Whirlwind affects all targets with Rend, causing them to Bleed for (190.465% of Attack Power) damage over 15 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 怒击的伤害提高15%。激怒时，怒击立即重置其冷却时间的几率提高10%。

selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Raging Blow has 2 charges and has a 25% chance to instantly reset its own cooldown.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 强化旋风斩激活时，暴怒的终结一击猛砸地面，对目标周围8码内的所有敌人造成([372.289% of Attack Power])点物理伤害。超过5个目标后伤害递减。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 激怒激活时受到的伤害降低10%。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 用两把武器发动一次强力打击，总计造成[([206.998% of Attack Power]) + ([206.998% of Attack Power])]点物理伤害。 [强化怒击: 怒击有25%的几率立即重置其冷却时间。]

selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Rampage has a 75% chance to refund a charge of Raging Blow and increase the damage of your next Raging Blow by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 释放一连串共计4次的残暴打击，造成总共[([203.065% of Attack Power]) + ([118.455% of Attack Power]) + ([270.756% of Attack Power]) + ([152.3% of Attack Power])]点物理伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Unleash a series of 4 brutal strikes for a total of [(203.065% of Attack Power) + (118.455% of Attack Power) + (270.756% of Attack Power) + (152.3% of Attack Power)] Physical damage.

Fury
Become an unstoppable storm of destructive force, striking all nearby enemies for [5 * (271.635% of Attack Power)%] Physical damage over 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 怒击的爆击几率提高5%，爆击伤害提高5%。

Whirlwind [Crashing Thunder: and Thunder Clap cause / causes] your next 4 single-target attacks to strike up to 4 additional targets for 65% damage.

 狂怒,  防护
你的攻击有一定几率使你的下一个斩杀可无视生命值高低对任意目标施放。
